backend/main.mo: Main actor defining types (Session, ContextSwitch, BreakSession, Achievement, Report, FocusScore) and implementing functions to record sessions, switches, breaks, achievements, focus scores, and generate reports with per-user storage in Maps.
backend/migration.mo: Migration module that adds focusScores field to the actor state, preserving existing data structures (sessions, switches, achievements, breaks, reports) during upgrades.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting implemented features including useFocusMonitor hook, distraction scoring, warning displays, backend data transmission, and burnout monitoring with associated test IDs and confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend components, pages, and hooks including Dashboard, LiveMonitor, break pages, achievements, reports, focus monitoring, burnout detection, and application categorization functionality.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark themes defining colors for backgrounds, foregrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar components using OKLCH color space.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point with root div and module script loading the React application at /src/main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root application component configuring TanStack Router with routes for Dashboard, LiveMonitor, AppCategorization, breaks, Achievements, and Reports, plus global overlays for burnout warnings, greyscale effects, and blocking screens.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsBadg: Achievement badge card component displaying title, description, image, unlock status, unlock date, and progress bar with conditional styling for locked/unlocked states.
frontend/src/components/AchievementsGall: Displays a grid of achievement badges with unlock status, progress, and share/export functionality. Shows count of unlocked achievements and allows sharing individual achievements to clipboard.
frontend/src/components/BlockScreen.tsx: Full-screen modal that blocks access to distracting apps during a 25-minute focus session. Displays countdown timer, progress bar, and productivity tips.
frontend/src/components/BurnoutWarning.t: Bottom-right toast notification that alerts users when burnout index is high, suggesting a desk recovery break. Dismissible with smooth fade animations.
frontend/src/components/DailyRecommendat: Card component displaying numbered list of personalized daily tips to improve user focus. Renders recommendations in styled muted boxes.
frontend/src/components/DistractionWarni: Non-intrusive bottom-right notification that appears when frequent tab switching is detected. Shows switch count and encourages focused work with dismissible action.
frontend/src/components/GreyscaleOverlay: Full-screen pointer-events-none overlay that applies grayscale filter based on intensity level. Uses backdrop-filter for visual desaturation effect.
frontend/src/components/Layout.tsx: Main application layout with sticky header navigation, quick action buttons for breaks, and footer. Includes dashboard, monitor, apps, achievements, and reports navigation items.
frontend/src/components/MetricsCard.tsx: Reusable card component for displaying a single metric with icon, value, and optional trend indicator. Shows trend direction with color-coded text.
frontend/src/components/PatternCard.tsx: Card displaying behavioral patterns with positive/negative styling, trend icons, title, description, and trend text. Uses green for positive and amber for negative patterns.
frontend/src/components/PeriodicReport.t: Report view with time period selector (week/month) that displays positive patterns and areas for improvement in grid layout. Includes export functionality and loading state.
frontend/src/components/ProductivityScor: Card with circular progress visualization showing daily productivity score (0-100) with color-coded labels (Excellent/Good/Fair/Needs Improvement) and contextual feedback message.
frontend/src/components/RecoveryQualityC: React component that renders a pie chart showing the percentage and duration of restorative vs. non-restorative breaks using Recharts and data from useBreakAnalytics hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useAchievements.ts: Hook that manages a static list of user achievements with unlock status, progress tracking, and a shareAchievement function for copying achievement text to clipboard.
Hook that simulates random application switching behavior, tracks switch counts and frequency metrics, and records switches to the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and manages the backend actor instance based on Internet Identity authentication state, invalidating dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useApplications.ts: Hook that manages a list of applications categorized as productive or distracting, persisting them to localStorage with CRUD operations.
frontend/src/hooks/useBlockingLogic.ts: Hook that implements warning-based blocking logic, blocking access after 2 warnings and requiring a 25-minute productive session to unblock.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakAnalytics.ts: Hook that returns hardcoded break analytics data showing 45 minutes of restorative time and 15 minutes of non-restorative time with calculated percentages.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreakTimer.ts: Hook that manages a countdown timer for desk recovery or walk breaks, recording break sessions to the backend actor when completed.
frontend/src/hooks/useBreathingAnimation: Hook that cycles through breathing phases (inhale, hold, exhale, rest) with corresponding scale animations when active, running on a 16-second cycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useBurnoutMonitor.ts: Hook that simulates burnout index tracking by randomly increasing a score over time, categorizing burnout levels, and allowing dismissal of warnings.
frontend/src/hooks/useDashboardData.ts: Hook that returns hardcoded dashboard metrics including focus time, distraction time, productivity score, burnout trend data, and personalized recommendations.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusMonitor.ts: Hook that monitors browser tab visibility and window focus events to calculate distraction metrics (switch count, switches per minute, time away) and sends focus session data to the backend.
frontend/src/hooks/useFocusTimer.ts: Hook that tracks and formats elapsed focus time in seconds while a focus session is active, resetting when inactive.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides React context and hooks for Internet Identity authentication, managing login state, identity persistence, and delegation validation with configurable AuthClient options.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Defines React Query hooks for fetching reports and focus scores, and a mutation hook for recording focus score data with automatic cache invalidation.
frontend/src/hooks/useReportData.ts: Returns mock positive and negative productivity patterns with loading state based on selected time period (week/month).
frontend/src/hooks/useWalkBreakTimer.ts: Manages a countdown timer for walk breaks with start/pause/reset controls, plays audio alert on completion, and records break data to the backend actor.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light and dark theme colors using a warm, supportive palette with soft blue-green primary colors.
frontend/src/lib/copyConstants.ts: Exports centralized UI copy text for app branding, dashboard messages, warnings, blocking screens, and break activity descriptions with benefits and tips.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/Achievements.tsx: Renders the achievements page with a header and the AchievementsGallery component to display productivity milestones.
frontend/src/pages/AppCategorization.tsx: Provides UI for adding, editing, and removing applications categorized as productive or distracting, with separate lists for each category.
frontend/src/pages/Dashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page displaying productivity metrics, focus time, distraction warnings, burnout trends, recovery quality charts, and daily recommendations with real-time focus monitoring.
frontend/src/pages/DeskRecovery.tsx: React page component for guided breathing exercises with animated breathing circle, timer controls (start/pause/reset), and instructional cards explaining the 4-second breathing technique.
frontend/src/pages/LiveMonitor.tsx: Real-time activity monitoring page displaying current application, productive/distracting categorization, continuous focus duration, and context switching metrics (switches per minute/hour).
frontend/src/pages/Reports.tsx: Simple wrapper page that renders the PeriodicReport component for displaying behavioral productivity reports and patterns.
frontend/src/pages/WalkBreak.tsx: Walk break timer page with configurable duration (5-60 minutes), progress bar, countdown display, and quick-select preset buttons for common break lengths.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: TypeScript type definitions for Application (with productive/distracting categories), ContextSwitch, and FocusSession data structures.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system, extended theme settings for borders/shadows/animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project metadata defining the productivity monitoring application architecture, including privacy-first design principles, burnout tracking algorithms, progressive intervention model, and completed feature implementations.
